scope: CPU attribution only; profile runs include calibration and are not paired timing samples.
script:
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,os
root=Path.cwd();out=root/'profiles';out.mkdir();env=dict(os.environ,GOMAXPROCS='2',CGO_ENABLED='0')
for name in ['baseline','candidate']:
 source=root/name;binary=out/(name+'.test');cpu=out/(name+'.cpu')
 subprocess.run(['go','test','-c','-o',str(binary),'./internal/changes'],cwd=source,env=env,check=True)
 r=subprocess.run([str(binary),'-test.run=^$','-test.bench=^BenchmarkRetainedTransferMetadata$/^1000$/^edit100$','-test.benchtime=10s','-test.cpuprofile='+str(cpu),'-test.benchmem'],cwd=source,env=env,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,text=True,check=True);(out/(name+'-bench.txt')).write_text(r.stdout)
 r=subprocess.run(['go','tool','pprof','-top','-nodecount=25',str(binary),str(cpu)],cwd=source,env=env,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,text=True,check=True);(out/(name+'-cpu.txt')).write_text(r.stdout)
 print(name,r.stdout,flush=True)
